title: Glow nine

reference.source: Antonin Waterkeyn, glow.mp4, Typographic Animations workshop, scenery.io/workshop; made in Cavalry
reference.grammar: one pink monoline numeral on a red card; one pink light orbits the card and, where it passes, the stroke blurs into white and thins to nothing

units: card widths; the card is 1 wide and 1.25 tall, y down; u,v on the plate are x / 1 and y / 1.25

ground.mixing: linear in sRGB between stops, by m

light.direction: counterclockwise on screen, top at t = 0

glyph.construction: monoline; Catmull-Rom through 19 control points, 4 samples per span, 72 segments

techniques.name: Orbiting light field

params.r: length(vec2(dot(q,u), 0.70 · dot(q,v))), q = p − light, u toward the card center, v across

techniques.implementation: One vec2 uniform. Every other value on the plate is a function of r, the squeezed distance to it.

techniques.name: Ground ramp
techniques.implementation: Six-stop ramp evaluated per pixel from m; the pink plateau and red far field are the same gradient read at its ends.

techniques.name: Centerline distance

params.caps: round (a min over segments gives them for free)

techniques.implementation: d = min over 72 segment distances, unrolled into the fragment shader at build time.

techniques.name: Closed-form variable blur

params.floor: σ ≥ 0.6 px so the crisp case stays antialiased

techniques.implementation: A stripe of half-width h convolved with a gaussian is two erfs; evaluating them per pixel gives a blur whose radius follows the light with no pyramid and no second pass.

techniques.name: Blur-driven taper
techniques.implementation: The stroke core is a second threshold on the same distance d, with a half-width that shrinks as the blur rises, so the needle point and the glow are one decision.

techniques.name: White glow
techniques.implementation: The blurred coverage b, pushed through a saturating curve and mixed toward white under the stroke; faded out where σ is near zero so the crisp stroke carries no halo.

pass_order: σ from r; b = blurred coverage
glow: mix toward white by f(b)
stroke core: threshold on d with the tapered half-width, drawn last
coupling: r decides the ground color, the blur radius and the taper, so the three cannot disagree about where the light is.

measured.light_path: top at 0 s, left at 2.25 s, bottom near 5 s, right near 7.5 s

inferred: the erf blur model and the taper curve; the Cavalry node setup was not seen
notes: Seedless. The still is deterministic: light at [−0.044, 0.531].
A pyramid blur would be the route for filled type; the closed form only holds for a stroke.
